turns.text: asked the Acting Minister for Transport (a) whether the Government measures the economic value of senior bus captains tasked with (i) mentoring new bus captains, and (ii) accompanying new bus captains on live routes; and (b) if so, how so.

turns.speaker: Mr Jeffrey Siow
turns.text: The Government does not specifically track the economic value of senior bus captains mentoring new bus captains and providing on-the-job training. However, bus operators do acknowledge the valuable role that senior bus captains play in guiding and mentoring newer colleagues, and reflect this through higher salaries or allowances.

reports.title: SkillsFuture Jobseeker Support Scheme for Previously Self-Employed Individuals and Business Owners Re-entering Workforce and Number of Beneficiaries to Date
reports.mp_names: Dr Tan See Leng,Ms Nadia Ahmad Samdin

turns.speaker: Ms Nadia Ahmad Samdin
turns.text: asked the Minister for Manpower (a) how the SkillsFuture Jobseeker Support scheme currently caters to support individuals who were previously self-employed or business owners but unfortunately needed to wind up their business and sought employment; and (b) how many of such individuals have benefited from the scheme to date.

turns.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
turns.text: The SkillsFuture Jobseeker Support scheme provides temporary financial support to individuals who become involuntarily unemployed. Individuals who were previously self-employed, including owners of sole proprietorships or partnerships who have ceased their businesses, are not eligible for the scheme.

reports.report_type: Written Answers to Questions for Oral Answer Not Answered by End of Question Time
reports.title: Exceptions to Cancer Drug Lists for Patients with Rare Cancers
reports.mp_names: Mr Christopher de Souza,Mr Ong Ye Kung

turns.speaker: Mr Christopher de Souza
turns.text: asked the Coordinating Minister for Social Policies and Minister for Health whether the Ministry will consider introducing greater flexibility or case-by-case exceptions under the Cancer Drug List (CDL) for patients with rare cancers who require clinically effective but non-CDL drugs, particularly where treatment costs remain exceptionally high despite insurance coverage.

turns.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
turns.text: The Ministry of Health will provide a combined reply to this Parliamentary Question (PQ), together with other PQs, which have been filed on this topic, at the next available opportunity.

reports.title: Data on Volume, Processing Time and Approval Amounts of Court Applications for Withdrawals from Frozen Accounts Connected to Scam Investigations
reports.mp_names: Ms Lee Hui Ying,Mr K Shanmugam

turns.speaker: Ms Lee Hui Ying
turns.text: asked the Coordinating Minister for National Security and Minister for Home Affairs regarding applications submitted over the past five years to the Courts for withdrawal of funds for daily living expenses from bank accounts frozen in connection with scam investigations (i) how many applications were received (ii) what is the average time taken for such funds to be released and (iii) what is the typical amount approved for withdrawal in these cases.

turns.speaker: Mr K Shanmugam
turns.text: The Government does not track such statistics.

reports.title: Breakdown of Bus Captain Profiles Across Public Transport Sector by Demographic and Educational Qualifications
reports.mp_names: Mr Jeffrey Siow,Mr Patrick Tay Teck Guan

turns.speaker: Mr Patrick Tay Teck Guan
turns.text: asked the Acting Minister for Transport what is the current profile of bus captains across the public transport sector by (i) age, (ii) nationality, and (iii) highest educational qualification attained.

turns.speaker: Mr Jeffrey Siow
turns.text: Of the 9,900 bus captains today, 30% are aged 40 and below; 57% are between 41 and 60; and 13% are aged above 60. Forty percent are Singaporean or Permanent Residents; with the rest being Work Permit holders. Eighty-five percent hold secondary or lower qualifications.

reports.title: Requiring Cooked Food Stallholders to Undergo Basic Fire Safety Training before Licensing

turns.text: asked the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment whether stallholders selling cooked food should be required to undergo basic fire safety training before being licensed.

turns.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
turns.text: The National Environment Agency partners with the Singapore Civil Defence Force and the National Fire and Emergency Preparedness Council to regularly engage and educate stall operators in hawker centres, including cooked food stallholders, on how to prevent and respond to fire emergencies.

reports.title: Requirements for SkillsFuture-funded Training Providers to Give Clear and Up-to-date Course Information
reports.mp_names: Dr Tan See Leng,Mr Patrick Tay Teck Guan

turns.text: asked the Minister for Manpower whether the Ministry will consider requiring all training providers that receive funding from SkillsFuture to provide clear and up-to-date course information on the SkillsFuture website, such as dates, instructor information and registration method, to reduce friction to sign-ups.

turns.text: The Skills and Workforce Development Agency already requires training providers to provide accurate and up-to-date course details on the MySkillsFuture portal.
